JOIN tip_material tm 
    ON td.tip_material_key = tm.tip_material_key 
JOIN tip_material_status tms 
    ON td.tip_material_status_key = tms.tip_material_status_key 
WHERE tso.warehouse_load_date = TO_DATE('2024-12-20', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
GROUP BY at.term_code, at.term_description, at.is_current_term

    w.warehouse_name,

    ho.order_total, 
    0, 
    0, 
    0, 
    0.0, 
    hc.cust_first_name, 
    hc.cust_last_name, 
    TRIM(TO_CHAR(ho.order_date, 'DAY')) AS DAYNAMECOL, 
    ho.customer_id AS STDDEVCOL, 
    w.warehouse_id AS COL_ALIAS,

FROM h_customers hc

SELECT 
    hc.cust_first_name,
    hc.cust_last_name,
    hc.cust_email,
    w.warehouse_name,
    ho.order_total,
    ho.order_date - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS COL_ALIAS,
    ho.order_date - 3 AS ADDDATE_INTCOL,
    TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(ho.order_date, 'DDD')) AS DAYOFYEARCOL,
    LENGTH(l.street_address) AS COL_ALIAS_0,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS PLACEHOLDER_COL,  -- For UNION type alignment
    TRUNC(ho.order_date) AS DATECOL
FROM 
    h_customers hc
    INNER JOIN h_orders ho ON hc.customer_id = ho.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN warehouses w
    INNER JOIN locations l ON w.location_id = l.location_id
WHERE 
    ho.order_total > 5000 
    AND l.country_id = 'US'
    AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (ho.order_date + INTERVAL '28' DAY)) 
        - EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ho.order_date) < 2
    AND NOT (l.street_address LIKE '%2004%')  -- Converted from = FALSE
    AND ho.mode IN ('direct', 'online')  -- ENUM handling

UNION ALL

    mlo.owner,
    ml.is_nfs_group,
    ml.is_moira_group,
    ml.is_moira_mailing_list,
    (mld.warehouse_load_date - mld.last_update_date) AS COL_ALIAS,  -- DATEDIFF replacement
    CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS PLACEHOLDER_DATE1,  -- For date column alignment
    CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS PLACEHOLDER_DATE2,
    member_counts.occurrences,
    0 AS ZERO_COL,
    ml.moira_list_name,

    JOIN (
        SELECT

            COUNT(moira_list_member) AS occurrences
        FROM 
            moira_list_detail 
        GROUP BY 
            moira_list_key
        HAVING 
            COUNT(moira_list_member) > 1000
    ) member_counts ON ml.moira_list_key = member_counts.moira_list_key
WHERE

SELECT 
    hc.cust_first_name, 
    hc.cust_last_name, 
    hc.cust_email, 
    w.warehouse_name, 
    ho.order_total, 
    (-4173.89 * w.location_id) AS COL_ALIAS, 
    CASE 
        WHEN hc.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN 
            CASE 
                WHEN hc.customer_id < 2 THEN 0
                WHEN hc.customer_id >= 27 THEN 16
                ELSE FLOOR((hc.customer_id - 2) * 15 / 25) + 1
            END
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS COL_ALIAS_0, 
    FORMAT(hc.customer_id, 2) AS COL_ALIAS_1, 
    CAST(DATE_FORMAT(ho.order_date, '%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS COL_ALIAS_2, 
    FORMAT(l.location_id, 2) AS COL_ALIAS_3 
FROM 
    h_customers hc 
    INNER JOIN h_orders ho ON hc.customer_id = ho.customer_id 
    CROSS JOIN warehouses w 
    INNER JOIN locations l ON w.location_id = l.location_id 
WHERE 
    ho.order_total > 5000 
    AND l.country_id = 'US' 
    AND CAST(EXTRACTVALUE(w.warehouse_spec, 'count(/Warehouse/Area)') AS UNSIGNED) > 0

SELECT 
    h.customer_id,
    SUM(h.order_total) AS total_order_amount,
    AVG(IF(c.account_mgr_id IS NOT NULL AND h.promotion_id IS NOT NULL, h.promotion_id, NULL)) AS COL_ALIAS,
    CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(h.customer_id) AS DATETIME) AS COL_ALIAS_0,
    TRUNCATE(h.customer_id, -5) AS COL_ALIAS_1,
    AVG(IF(w.location_id IS NOT NULL AND h.customer_id IS NOT NULL, w.location_id, NULL)) AS COL_ALIAS_2,
    CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS cust_email,
    CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS warehouse_name,
    CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS cust_first_name,
    CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS cust_last_name,
    CAST(h.customer_id AS DOUBLE) AS GETXCOL,
    0 AS STRPOSCOL
FROM h_orders h
INNER JOIN h_customers c ON h.customer_id = c.customer_id
INNER JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_name = 'New Jersey'
GROUP BY h.customer_id
HAVING SUM(h.order_total) > 1000
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(DAY_OF_YEAR FROM ho.order_date) AS customer_id,
    ho.order_total AS total_order_amount,
    0.0 AS COL_ALIAS,
    CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS COL_ALIAS_0,
    0 AS COL_ALIAS_1,
    0.0 AS COL_ALIAS_2,
    hc.cust_email,
    w.warehouse_name,
    hc.cust_first_name,
    hc.cust_last_name,
    ST_X(w.wh_geo_location) AS GETXCOL,
    INSTR(hc.cust_email, 'E.E') AS STRPOSCOL
FROM h_customers hc
INNER JOIN h_orders ho ON hc.customer_id = ho.customer_id
CROSS JOIN warehouses w
INNER JOIN locations l ON w.location_id = l.location_id
WHERE ho.order_total > 5000

    library_subject_offered.num_enrolled_students % 2 AS REMAINDERCOL,
    UPPER(FORMAT(library_course_instructor.date_to, 'dd MMM yyyy', 'de-DE')) AS COL_ALIAS,
    CASE 
        WHEN library_subject_offered.num_enrolled_students IS NOT NULL 
        THEN 
            CASE 
                WHEN ISNULL(library_subject_offered.num_enrolled_students, 0) < -7 THEN 0
                WHEN ISNULL(library_subject_offered.num_enrolled_students, 0) >= 7 THEN 11
                ELSE FLOOR((ISNULL(library_subject_offered.num_enrolled_students, 0) + 7) * 10.0 / 14) + 1 
            END
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS COL_ALIAS_0,
    DATEDIFF(SECOND, library_reserve_matrl_detail.warehouse_load_date, library_reserve_catalog.catalog_record_create_date) / 86400.0 AS COL_ALIAS_0_1,
    CAST(library_reserve_catalog.warehouse_load_date AS DATE) AS COL_ALIAS_1,
    '$' + FORMAT(library_subject_offered.num_enrolled_students, '#,##0.00', 'de-DE') AS COL_ALIAS_2,
    CAST('2029-03-26T13:29:31' AS DATETIME2) AS COL_ALIAS_3

JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail ON library_course_instructor.library_course_instructor_key = library_reserve_matrl_detail.library_course_instructor_key
JOIN library_subject_offered ON library_subject_offered.library_subject_offered_key = library_reserve_matrl_detail.library_subject_offered_key
JOIN library_reserve_catalog ON library_reserve_catalog.library_reserve_catalog_key = library_reserve_matrl_detail.library_reserve_catalog_key

SELECT 
    hc.cust_first_name AS first_name,
    w.warehouse_name AS nearest_warehouse,
    CHARINDEX('s', hc.cust_email) AS INSTR2COL,
    CONVERT(DATE, 'Apr 29, 1974', 106) AS COL_ALIAS,
    MONTH(ho.order_date) AS COL_ALIAS_0,
    PARSE('-2.611,8' AS DECIMAL USING 'de-DE') * hc.account_mgr_id AS COL_ALIAS_1,
    CASE 
        WHEN ho.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN
            CASE 
                WHEN COALESCE(ho.customer_id, 0) < 8 THEN 0
                WHEN COALESCE(ho.customer_id, 0) >= 18 THEN 7
                ELSE CAST(FLOOR((COALESCE(ho.customer_id, 0) - 8) * 6.0 / 10) + 1 AS INT)
            END
        ELSE NULL
    END AS COL_ALIAS_2,
    SUBSTRING(hc.nls_language, 4, 4) AS COL_ALIAS_3,
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), ho.order_date, 120) AS COL_ALIAS_4
FROM h_customers hc
INNER JOIN h_orders ho ON hc.customer_id = ho.customer_id
CROSS JOIN warehouses w
LEFT JOIN locations l ON w.location_id = l.location_id
WHERE 
    ho.order_total > 10000
    AND w.warehouse_spec.exist('/Warehouse/Parking') = 1

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN cha.cis_attribute_group_note LIKE '%HASS_ATTRIBUTE,%' 
        THEN ccso.master_subject_id 
        ELSE sd.dept_budget_code 
    END AS IFCOL,
    (ata.pre_registration_start_day - ata.graduate_award_end_date) AS COL_ALIAS,
    (ccso.total_units / ccso.lecture_units) AS DIVCOL,
    (CAST(cha.icon_width AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / ccso.total_units AS COL_ALIAS_0,
    CAST(ccso.total_units AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS COL_ALIAS_1,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM sd.department_last_activity_date) AS COL_ALIAS_2,
    ccso.lecture_units::DOUBLE PRECISION AS COL_ALIAS_3,
    TO_CHAR(sd.department_last_activity_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS COL_ALIAS_4
FROM course_catalog_subject_offered ccso 
JOIN cis_hass_attribute cha ON ccso.hass_attribute = cha.hass_attribute 
JOIN sis_department sd ON ccso.department_code = sd.department_code 
JOIN academic_terms_all ata ON ccso.term_code = ata.term_code 
WHERE cha.cis_attribute_group = 'H'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN t2.closeddate IS NULL THEN 'NOT well-finished' 
        ELSE 'well-finished' 
    END AS resylt,
    (t2.communityowneddate::date - t2.creaiondate::date) AS COL_ALIAS,
    t1.postid AS DIVCOL,
    t1.userid::DOUBLE PRECISION AS COL_ALIAS_0,
    t2.id::DOUBLE PRECISION AS COL_ALIAS_1,
    t1.postid::DOUBLE PRECISION AS COL_ALIAS_2,
    CAST(t2.score AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS COL_ALIAS_3,
    NULL AS COL_ALIAS_4
FROM comments AS t1 
INNER JOIN posts AS t2 ON t1.postid = t2.id 
WHERE t1.userid = 23853 
  AND t1.creationdate = '2013-07-12 09:08:18.0'

SELECT 
    nation,
    o_year,
    SUM(amount) AS sum_profit,
    CONCAT(FORMAT(o_year, 0), '.000') AS COL_ALIAS,
    INSTR('LGE', nation) AS STRPOSCOL,
    RPAD(nation, 2, ' ') AS RPADCOL,
    (
        (COUNT(*) * SUM(amount * o_year) - SUM(amount) * SUM(o_year))
        / NULLIF(
            (COUNT(*) * SUM(o_year * o_year) - SUM(o_year) * SUM(o_year),
            0
        )
    ) AS COL_ALIAS_0,
    o_year AS COL_ALIAS_1,
    SUM(CASE WHEN nation LIKE '%ALGERIA%' THEN o_year END) AS COL_ALIAS_2,
    SUM(CASE WHEN nation LIKE '%ALGERIA%' THEN amount END) AS COL_ALIAS_3,
    CAST('1305' AS DOUBLE) AS COL_ALIAS_4
FROM (
    SELECT 
        n_name AS nation,
        YEAR(o_orderdate) AS o_year,
        l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) - ps_supplycost * l_quantity AS amount
    FROM 
        part,
        supplier,
        lineitem,
        partsupp,
        orders,
        nation
    WHERE 
        s_suppkey = l_suppkey
        AND ps_suppkey = l_suppkey
        AND ps_partkey = l_partkey
        AND p_partkey = l_partkey
        AND o_orderkey = l_orderkey
        AND s_nationkey = n_nationkey
        AND p_name LIKE '%green%'

mysql: WITH subjectcounts AS ( SELECT term_code , fall_instructors , subject_id , COUNT( * ) OVER ( PARTITION BY term_code ) AS total_subjects , COUNT( * ) OVER ( PARTITION BY fall_instructors ) AS experience FROM course_catalog_subject_offered WHERE term_code = '2023FA' ) SELECT hc.cust_first_name , hc.cust_last_name , hc.cust_email , w.warehouse_name , ho.order_total , ST_X( hc.cust_geo_location ) AS GETXCOL , ST_Y( hc.cust_geo_location ) AS GETYCOL , LAST_DAY( ho.order_date ) AS COL_ALIAS , YEAR( ho.order_date ) AS YEARCOL , ST_LONGITUDE( w.wh_geo_location ) AS COL_ALIAS_0 , DATE '2025-05-30' AS COL_ALIAS_1 , DAYOFWEEK(ho.order_date) AS DAYOFWEEKCOL FROM h_customers hc INNER JOIN h_orders ho ON hc.customer_id = ho.customer_id CROSS JOIN warehouses w INNER JOIN locations l ON w.location_id = l.location_id WHERE ho.order_total > 5000 AND l.country_id = 'US' AND REGEXP_LIKE( hc.cust_first_name , '.*Matthias.*' , 'c' ) UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ccso.fall_instructors , ccso.prerequisites , ccso.subject_title , at.term_description , DATEDIFF( at.warehouse_load_date , at.graduate_award_start_date ) AS COL_ALIAS , sc.experience , sc.total_subjects , DATE '2025-05-30' , 0.0 , 0.0 , STR_TO_DATE( at.financial_aid_year , '%Y' ) AS COL_ALIAS_0 , 0 AS DAYOFWEEKCOL FROM course_catalog_subject_offered ccso JOIN academic_terms at ON ccso.term_code = at.term_code JOIN subjectcounts sc ON ccso.term_code = sc.term_code AND ccso.subject_id = sc.subject_id WHERE ccso.term_code = '2023FA'
